other_conditions: Must be incorporated as a private limited company, partnership firm, or limited liability partnership.
Must be within ten years from the date of incorporation/registration.
Turnover for any financial year since incorporation must not exceed ₹100 crore.
Must be working towards innovation, product/process/service improvement, or a scalable business model with high employment or wealth‑creation potential.
Entity formed by splitting up or reconstruction of an existing business is not eligible.
Must be incorporated or registered in Bihar and have an office in Bihar.
Applicable taxes from the company's operations must be payable in Bihar.
benefits_summary: Interest‑free loans up to ₹10 lakh for ten years, plus a 5% incentive for female entrepreneurs and a ₹3 lakh grant for participants in product‑improvement training.
